title: Selling a car that you lease
text: If you lease your car, the leasing company owns it, so selling it to us is really a buyout from the leasing company. First, check that your leasing company allows third-party buyouts ([Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts](kb:lessor_buyouts)). Then ask them for a dealer payoff quote, which can be different from the payoff they quote to you. Or sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, and we request the dealer payoff quote for you. Bring the quote to your appointment. If our offer is higher than the buyout, see [If our offer is more than your lease buyout](kb:lease_equity).

title: Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts
text: Not every leasing company lets us buy out your lease. Harbor Leasing: not allowed. Summit Auto Lease: allowed. Crescent Motor Credit: not allowed. Apex Lease Co: allowed. Bluewater Leasing: allowed only if you also buy a car from Northwind. Ironwood Lease: not allowed. If yours doesn't allow it, you can buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease ([Selling vs. turning in at lease end](kb:lease_vs_turn_in)).

title: Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts
text: Not every leasing company lets us buy out your lease. Harbor Leasing: not allowed. Summit Auto Lease: allowed. Crescent Motor Credit: allowed since February 1, 2026. Apex Lease Co: allowed; since February 1, 2026, Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount. Bluewater Leasing: allowed only if you also buy a car from Northwind. Ironwood Lease: not allowed. If yours doesn't allow it, you can buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease ([Selling vs. turning in at lease end](kb:lease_vs_turn_in)). To get started, see [Selling a car that you lease](kb:leased_car).

title: If our offer is more than your lease buyout
text: If our offer is higher than your lease buyout amount, the difference is lease equity. Who gets it depends on your leasing company. Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass it to you. Bluewater Leasing applies it to the car you buy from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all ([Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts](kb:lessor_buyouts)). If our offer is lower than the buyout, you pay the difference at the appointment, the same as [negative equity](kb:negative_equity).

title: Selling vs. turning in at lease end
text: At the end of a lease you can turn the car in to the leasing company or sell it. Turning in is simpler, but you may pay for extra miles or wear. Selling can make sense when the car is worth more than the buyout amount ([If our offer is more than your lease buyout](kb:lease_equity)). Get an offer from us before your turn-in date and compare it with your buyout quote.
